from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List

class UniversityAdmissions(BaseModel):
    """Captures admission statistics for a single university from one document."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    applicants: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year applicants")
    admitted: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year admitted students")
    enrolled: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year enrolled students")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for the data (e.g., Fall 2021)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates admission data for all universities in the document collection."""
    universities: List[UniversityAdmissions]
